name: Oppresseur de Mars
description: Artilleur orbital bombardant les fortifications ennemies depuis les stations en orbite martienne.

subject.archetype: Human Heavy Artilleryman of the Martian Hegemony (Purist)

loadout.armor_outfit: Full-body seamless plate armor in deep carmine red with dark grey angular accents; smooth, impurity‑free surfaces embodying purist purity; integral helmet with opaque visor and a thin horizontal red slit; angular shoulder plates; asymmetric half‑cape with sharp, geometric edges for officer rank; ballistic fabric underlayer.
loadout.arsenal: Integrated orbital railgun artillery system featuring a massive rectangular/octagonal barrel, no visible mechanisms; high‑power plasma‑charged projectile; a compact thermal energy sword at the hip with a red‑glowing, smoky blade.

attitude.behavior: Stands on the edge of an orbital artillery platform, legs braced wide, the massive railgun raised and aimed at an enemy fortification far below; red plasma energy crackles at the muzzle; recoil absorbed by the heavy armor.
attitude.emotion: Cold, relentless focus behind the opaque visor; an expressionless mask of domination, the faint red glow of the visor slit reflecting the weapon's charging energy.

palette_names.name: Red Neon Glow
palette_names.role: Accent energy glow (visor slit, plasma discharge, reactor vents)

color_and_light.lighting_setup: Cinematic rim lighting with a strong backlight to accentuate the angular silhouette, supplemented by localized red neon glow from the weapon and reactor; subtle starlight from the void of space.

scenography.setting: Orbital artillery station hovering above the rust‑red surface of Mars; the planet’s curvature and faint atmospheric haze visible below; a star‑filled void surrounds the platform.
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Red plasma energy discharge at the cannon muzzle, faint particulate dust drifting in micro‑gravity, subtle lens flare from the starfield, occasional glowing hexagon grilles on the station’s hull.
